title: GitHub-owned workflow for ChatGPT browser development
intent: Make successive ChatGPT browser threads recover and develop OntoKin from explicit GitHub-owned instructions, task state, skills and evidence.

requirements.description: GitHub holds the operational workflow and current checkpoint.
requirements.acceptance: One stable entry URL and reusable prompt locate the current task without a ZIP or prior chat.

requirements.description: Read instructions explicitly at an observed revision.
requirements.acceptance: Entry instructions require AGENTS, GOAL, STATUS, ROLE, current task and selected skills; distinguish Codex discovery from browser behavior.

requirements.description: Use capabilities actually available in the session.
requirements.acceptance: Record read/write/merge/test/subagent access; unavailable tools produce precise limits, never fictional execution or a universal browser restriction.

requirements.description: Give one Director accountability and bounded worker roles.
requirements.acceptance: Assignments identify owner, inputs, write scope, evidence and stop condition; one verified owner integrates main.
Each requirement has a stable ID, observable acceptance and evidence; user changes revise scope explicitly.
Every requirement maps to a plan step with outputs, verification and status; completion cannot leave an in-scope requirement unaccounted for.

requirements.description: Recover work across chats and unknown write outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Reconcile live refs/PRs/lease with checkpoint; resume the existing scope; record unpublished work and retry only after readback.

requirements.description: Record actual verification and honest completion.
requirements.acceptance: Changes have revision-specific checks and review; unrun/failed checks remain visible; structural checks do not certify live GitHub or product semantics.

requirements.description: Integrate completed work and resolve its branch.
requirements.acceptance: Verify PR/main result and head retention, then confirm deletion or give the owner the exact safe-to-delete branch.

requirements.description: Retain project memory and lessons with evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Read-only retrieval exposes source and applicability; completion considers a deduplicated lesson; opt-outs are respected and historical memory cannot overrule current instructions.
Terms, typed relationships and capability limits link to adopted sources; the map does not introduce new OntoKin semantics or an inference engine.

requirements.description: Load reusable repository skills only when relevant.
requirements.acceptance: A registry names each skill, trigger and path; skill files are explicitly read and are not represented as installed browser features.

requirements.description: Supply small executable workflow tools and a browser-only route.
requirements.acceptance: Standard-library check, brief, lookup and draft-task creation work; connector-only sessions can follow the same records manually without claiming unrun tests.

requirements.description: Preserve OntoKin's product and operational constraints.
requirements.acceptance: Product source, fixtures, budgets, frozen evidence and manual-only hosted workflows remain unchanged; current documentation keeps earlier failures and deferred domains visible.

requirements.description: Ground the adaptation in the supplied sources.
requirements.acceptance: Source register distinguishes inspected files, official documentation, verified video metadata and missing implementation/transcript evidence.

requirements.description: Finish one bounded workflow delivery and stop.
requirements.acceptance: Current state records completion, links to evidence and waits for user direction; the scientific next task remains a separately selectable scope.
